title: Salesforce Devops
description:
CXCRM Recruitment

Dear Candidate  
Greetings from Cognizant!!

**Job Title:** Salesforce DevOps Developer

**Experience:** 4 to 12 years

**Location:** All CTS Location (3 days office, Hybrid mode)

**Notice Period:** Immediate to 90 days

#### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled **Salesforce DevOps Developer** with strong Salesforce development expertise and hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, version control, and release management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for automating deployments, streamlining development processes, and ensuring high-quality Salesforce releases across environments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs.
* Manage source code repositories using Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
* Automate deployments using Salesforce DX (SFDX), Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Perform code reviews and enforce development best practices.
* Manage branching, merging, release strategies, and environment synchronization.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth releases.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues and optimize release processes.
* Implement security, compliance, and governance standards across Salesforce environments.
* Support Agile development and DevOps transformation initiatives.
